comparison: Perfect agreement on protection against weight loss and mortality (C16, C17, C22, C23, C53, C54, C91, C93). Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED and affirm the protective efficacy findings with similar emphasis on disease prevention.

Complete agreement on infection and dissemination findings (C18-C28). Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED and acknowledge that L. biflexa pre-exposure does not prevent infection or colonization, treating this as an important mechanistic distinction.

Agreement on kidney protection evidence (C29-C33, C57-C58, C92). Both rate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes age-related confounding (C59) as appropriately acknowledged; peer review addresses this concern separately in R7.

Agreement on antibody response data (C34-C36, C96). Both rate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval provides detailed analysis of IgG2a specificity and Th1 interpretation; peer review acknowledges this as part of immune characterization without detailed critique.

Both address cellular immune responses (C38-C42), rated SUPPORTED. OpenEval focuses specifically on flow cytometry data for these claims; peer review combines these with T cell subset analysis (C43-C47, C95) in a single evaluation acknowledging immune characterization broadly.

OpenEval evaluates T cell subset analysis (C43-C47, C95) as SUPPORTED with detailed discussion of activation markers. Peer review combines this with broader cellular immune data (including C38-C42) in R5, treating all as supporting evidence without detailed critique.

Divergent evaluations of bacterial shedding correlation (C78, C94, C99). OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN, noting speculative mechanistic interpretation requiring additional studies. Peer review rates as SUPPORTED, acknowledging comprehensive characterization without challenging the homeostasis interpretation.

Both address vaccine potential and heterologous protection claims (C63-C64, C75, C97). OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN due to limited testing of one serovar and speculative application. Peer review rates as SUPPORTED, strongly affirming novelty and importance (also includes C69 from OpenEval R14).

Divergent evaluations of age-dependent effects (C55-C56, C59). OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED, noting appropriate acknowledgment of confounding factor. Peer review rates as UNCERTAIN, explicitly critiquing lack of reasoning for phenotype differences and identifying this as preventing direct comparison between experiments.
OpenEval evaluates cross-reactive epitope claims (C49-C50) as SUPPORTED based on citation to prior work. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
OpenEval evaluates background epidemiology claims (C1-C5) as SUPPORTED. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers did not assess background context claims.
OpenEval evaluates taxonomic and ecological background (C6-C14) as SUPPORTED. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers did not assess background context claims.

OpenEval evaluates novelty and comparison claims (C68-C73) as SUPPORTED with appropriate caveats. Peer review R8 overlaps on C69 and strongly affirms novelty and importance, rating as SUPPORTED with emphasis on field significance.

Both address limitations and future directions. OpenEval evaluates discussion points (C48, C51-C52, C74, C76-C77, C80) as SUPPORTED with appropriate caveats. Peer review R9 specifically addresses C74 acknowledgment of cross-protection testing needs, rating as SUPPORTED without challenge.

OpenEval evaluates experimental methods (C81-C90) as SUPPORTED with appropriate design elements. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers did not separately assess methodological claims.
